This is the third record-setting packing found with a rational side length, thanks to the Pythagorean triple determining its tilt angle. It is the first record-setting packing to use the same Pythagorean triple as the found by David Ellsworth in December 2024 (the first competitively-intended packing found with a rational side length, though not record-setting). It's the second record-setting packing found that is doubly semi-primitive, i.e. has only non-rotated squares on its leftmost and rightmost sides, but has rotated square(s) poking into its top and bottom sides.
